note: Versioned pipeline registry (safe-versioning policy, docs/15). Select the active pipeline with ONE value (env PIPELINE_MODE overrides `active`), never by editing source. PRODUCTION = `legacy`, the original Higgsfield lifecycle, restored by explicit user instruction 2026-07-16. `composite-v1` is retained intact for experimentation but is NOT production. Neither version may be switched automatically in either direction - only by explicit user instruction. Geometry is enforced by QC (docs/18): reject and regenerate any output whose jewelry differs from source; never approve or deliver it.

policy.legacy_activation: ACTIVE BY EXPLICIT USER INSTRUCTION 2026-07-16 (restore-original-lifecycle). This is a deliberate, user-ordered production baseline - not an automatic fallback. Automatic switching between versions remains forbidden in both directions.

composite-v1.description: RETAINED, NOT PRODUCTION (user-instructed 2026-07-16). Higgsfield renders only the scene; the real source-CAD ring is composited in - geometry identical by construction. Kept intact in the repository for future experimentation. Never part of the production workflow and never selected automatically.

legacy.description: PRODUCTION (user-restored 2026-07-16). The original Higgsfield MCP lifecycle that generated the previously approved catalogs: Higgsfield renders the scene AND the jewelry from the approved prompts; the preserved logo is composited locally afterwards (docs/04 P0 - AI never renders the logo). Geometry is NOT guaranteed by construction; it is enforced by QC - any output whose jewelry differs from source is REJECTED and regenerated, never delivered (docs/18).

terminology.Higgsfield: The only production image generation engine (docs/21). The production pipeline is `legacy` - the original Higgsfield lifecycle in which Higgsfield generates the scene AND the jewelry.
terminology.Composite-first: `composite-v1`. Higgsfield renders only the scene; the CAD ring is composited in. Retained for experimentation; NOT production.
terminology.Logo compositing: NOT a pipeline. The preserved logo is composited locally in BOTH versions - required by docs/04 P0 in all cases and unaffected by this switch.
terminology.note: Both versions call Higgsfield. The distinction is whether Higgsfield draws the RING. Production = legacy = Higgsfield draws it, QC rejects drift.
